resources.string: Open New Chat and paste the profile link they gave you, or scan their QR code. If a name search comes up empty, ask for their profile link.
Open Share & connect to show your QR code or send your profile link. Keep your private sign-in key to yourself.
Touch and hold a message to find its actions. Try it on this example.
Choose Reply to quote the message in your response, or choose an emoji to react.
